prompt: awk next statement executed END action historical behavior
answer:
If `next` causes the end of input to be reached, the `END` actions are executed. The GNU Awk User’s Guide states this explicitly: “If the `next` statement causes the end of the input to be reached, then the code in any `END` rules will be executed.”  
<http://odysseus.fi.muni.cz/pub/gnu/old-gnu/Manuals/gawk-3.0.3/html_node/gawk_104.es.html>

However, using `next` *within* a `BEGIN` or `END` action has undefined behavior under POSIX; `gawk` treats it as a syntax error.  
<https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799.2018edition/utilities/awk.html>
